title: Mark Walter's TWG Global says there's 'no fraud' amid probe of insurers' disclosures
summary: Mark Walter, the billionaire owner of the Los Angeles Dodgers, is currently under scrutiny due to his decision to sell his majority stake in the LA Lakers. Despite the ongoing investigation into insurers' disclosures, Walter asserts that there is 'no fraud' involved. This situation has attracted significant media attention, highlighting the complexities of ownership in high-profile sports franchises. The implications of this sale could have far-reaching effects on both the Lakers and the broader sports culture.
